title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第三十三章、大火中的真相

    李妃被打入了冷宫。楚珠想在夜晚翻墙出去帮李妃找回孩子，但那晚冷宫发生了大火。
    “根据内班院的记录，冷宫火灾是因为一个宫女不小心在睡梦中打翻烛台而发生的一场意外。因灾死亡人数二十三人，含李妃、二十名宫女和两名太监。你对内班院的这份记录，有没有意见？”包拯问楚珠。
    仿佛听到了可笑的事情，楚珠笑了，泪从眼角流下来。她悲愤地说：“没有人打翻烛台，是有人在杀人放火！”她抬手指向张怀，大声说：“那天深夜，所有人都睡了，张怀带着人来冷宫了！当时我在院墙边，正想办法翻墙出去，一看到他来就躲起来了。我看到张怀拿着刀，进了娘娘的房间。他进去后没多久，房间里就传出宫女惊恐的叫声，过了一会儿，张怀拿着刀从房间里出来了，刀上全是血。他叫人拿来火把，扔在娘娘的房间门口，火烧起来，有几个宫女被惊醒了，穿着睡衣出来救火，但都被张怀杀了。我等张怀和他的人离开后，马上冲进火海，跑进娘娘的房间，看到地上躺着四个宫女，身上全是血，她们都死了。娘娘躺在床上，脸上和身上满是刀伤，我以为娘娘也死了，但抱着她哭的时候看到她的眼睛动了一下。床已经着火了，我把娘娘拖到了地上。这时候我发现床下还藏着一个小宫女，我把她从床下拉出来，她没有受伤，张怀进来的时候她躲在床下了，张怀没有发现她。她被吓坏了，一直害怕地哭，我没有时间理她，继续拖娘娘，我想把娘娘拖到没有火的地方。她看到了，哭着过来帮我。我要感谢她，她是冷宫的宫女，她知道那个房间有个后门，虽然她很胆小，但在她的指引和帮助下，我把娘娘从那个后门拖出来了。我们找到一个破旧的小库房，藏在了那里。娘娘的伤很重，她只有一口气了。外面的大火也还在烧，我们很害怕，因为冷宫不大，这个小库房迟早会被人发现。”
    “你们为什么要躲起来？为什么不出去找人帮忙？”皇帝忍不住问道。
    “找人帮忙？”楚珠含着泪悲愤地笑起来，她问：“皇上，您去过冷宫吗？您知道什么是罪人吗？您知道被打入冷宫的罪人是没有机会再出去的吗？您知道冷宫里死一个人是不会有人关心的吗？”
    皇帝的表情很复杂，他沉默了。
    包拯的心情也很沉重，他问：“那个帮助你的宫女叫什么名字？”
    “蓝香，她叫蓝香。”
fullText.traditional:
第三十三章、大火中的真相

    李妃被打入了冷宮。楚珠想在夜晚翻牆出去幫李妃找回孩子，但那晚冷宮發生了大火。
    “根據內班院的記錄，冷宮火災是因為一個宮女不小心在睡夢中打翻燭臺而發生的一場意外。因災死亡人數二十三人，含李妃、二十名宮女和兩名太監。你對內班院的這份記錄，有沒有意見？”包拯問楚珠。
    彷彿聽到了可笑的事情，楚珠笑了，淚從眼角流下來。她悲憤地說：“沒有人打翻燭臺，是有人在殺人放火！”她抬手指向張懷，大聲說：“那天深夜，所有人都睡了，張懷帶著人來冷宮了！當時我在院牆邊，正想辦法翻牆出去，一看到他來就躲起來了。我看到張懷拿著刀，進了娘娘的房間。他進去後沒多久，房間裡就傳出宮女驚恐的叫聲，過了一會兒，張懷拿著刀從房間裡出來了，刀上全是血。他叫人拿來火把，扔在娘娘的房間門口，火燒起來，有幾個宮女被驚醒了，穿著睡衣出來救火，但都被張懷殺了。我等張懷和他的人離開後，馬上衝進火海，跑進娘娘的房間，看到地上躺著四個宮女，身上全是血，她們都死了。娘娘躺在床上，臉上和身上滿是刀傷，我以為娘娘也死了，但抱著她哭的時候看到她的眼睛動了一下。床已經著火了，我把娘娘拖到了地上。這時候我發現床下還藏著一個小宮女，我把她從床下拉出來，她沒有受傷，張懷進來的時候她躲在床下了，張懷沒有發現她。她被嚇壞了，一直害怕地哭，我沒有時間理她，繼續拖娘娘，我想把娘娘拖到沒有火的地方。她看到了，哭著過來幫我。我要感謝她，她是冷宮的宮女，她知道那個房間有個後門，雖然她很膽小，但在她的指引和幫助下，我把娘娘從那個後門拖出來了。我們找到一個破舊的小庫房，藏在了那裡。娘娘的傷很重，她只有一口氣了。外面的大火也還在燒，我們很害怕，因為冷宮不大，這個小庫房遲早會被人發現。”
    “你們為什麼要躲起來？為什麼不出去找人幫忙？”皇帝忍不住問道。
    “找人幫忙？”楚珠含著淚悲憤地笑起來，她問：“皇上，您去過冷宮嗎？您知道什麼是罪人嗎？您知道被打入冷宮的罪人是沒有機會再出去的嗎？您知道冷宮裡死一個人是不會有人關心的嗎？”
    皇帝的表情很複雜，他沉默了。
    包拯的心情也很沉重，他問：“那個幫助你的宮女叫什麼名字？”
    “藍香，她叫藍香。”

sentences.traditional: 我們很害怕，因為冷宮不大，這個小庫房遲早會被人發現。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men hěn hài pà yīn wèi lěng gōng bú dà zhè ge xiǎo kù fáng chí zǎo huì bèi rén fā xiàn
sentences.english: We were very scared because the Cold Palace was not big, and the small storeroom would be discovered sooner or later.”

sentences.simplified: “你们为什么要躲起来？为什么不出去找人帮忙？”皇帝忍不住问道。
sentences.traditional: “你們為什麼要躲起來？為什麼不出去找人幫忙？”皇帝忍不住問道。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ men wèi shén me yào duǒ qǐ lái wèi shén me bù chū qù zhǎo rén bāng máng huáng dì rěn bú zhù wèn dào
sentences.english: “Why were you hiding? Why didn’t you go out and find help?” the emperor couldn’t help but ask.

sentences.simplified: “找人帮忙？”楚珠含着泪悲愤地笑起来，
sentences.traditional: “找人幫忙？”楚珠含著淚悲憤地笑起來，
sentences.pinyin: zhǎo rén bāng máng chǔ zhū hán zhe lèi bēi fèn de xiào qǐ lái
sentences.english: “Find help?” Chu Zhu laughed indignantly with tears in her eyes.

sentences.simplified: 她问：“皇上，您去过冷宫吗？您知道什么是罪人吗？
sentences.traditional: 她問：“皇上，您去過冷宮嗎？您知道什麼是罪人嗎？
sentences.pinyin: tā wèn huáng shang nín qù guò lěng gōng ma nín zhī dào shén me shì zuì rén ma
sentences.english: She asked, “Your Majesty, have you ever been to the Cold Palace? Do you know what a wrongdoer is?

sentences.simplified: 您知道被打入冷宫的罪人是没有机会再出去的吗？
sentences.traditional: 您知道被打入冷宮的罪人是沒有機會再出去的嗎？
sentences.pinyin: nín zhī dào bèi dǎ rù lěng gōng de zuì rén shì méi yǒu jī huì zài chū qù de ma
sentences.english: Did you know that the wrongdoers who are banished to the Cold Palace never have a chance to get out?

sentences.simplified: 您知道冷宫里死一个人是不会有人关心的吗？”
sentences.traditional: 您知道冷宮裡死一個人是不會有人關心的嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: nín zhī dào lěng gōng lǐ sǐ yí ge rén shì bú huì yǒu rén guān xīn de ma
sentences.english: Did you know that no one cares if someone dies in the Cold Palace?”

sentences.simplified: 皇帝的表情很复杂，他沉默了。
sentences.traditional: 皇帝的表情很複雜，他沉默了。
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì de biǎo qíng hěn fù zá tā chén mò le
sentences.english: The emperor’s expression was very complex. He fell silent.

sentences.simplified: 包拯的心情也很沉重，他问：“那个帮助你的宫女叫什么名字？”
sentences.traditional: 包拯的心情也很沉重，他問：“那個幫助你的宮女叫什麼名字？”
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng de xīn qíng yě hěn chén zhòng tā wèn nà ge bāng zhù nǐ de gōng nǚ jiào shén me míng zi
sentences.english: Bao Zheng also had a heavy heart. He asked, “What was the name of the palace maid who helped you?”

sentences.simplified: “蓝香，她叫蓝香。”
sentences.traditional: “藍香，她叫藍香。”
sentences.pinyin: lán xiāng tā jiào lán xiāng
sentences.english: “Lan Xiang, her name is Lan Xiang.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 33: The Truth in the Great Fire
Consort Li was banished to the Cold Palace.
Chu Zhu wanted to climb over the wall at night to help Consort Li find her child, but a great fire broke out in the Cold Palace that night.
“According to the records from the Department of Inner Palace Affairs, ..
.. the fire in the Cold Palace was an accident caused by a palace maid who accidentally knocked over a candlestick in her sleep.
The number of deaths due to the fire was twenty-three, including Consort Li, twenty palace maids, and two eunuchs.
Do you have any opinions on these records from the Department of Inner Palace Affairs?” Bao Zheng asked Chu Zhu.
As if she had heard something ridiculous, Chu Zhu laughed, with tears streaming down from the corners of her eyes.
She said with grief and indignation, “No one knocked over a candlestick. Someone was committing murder and arson!”
She raised her hand, pointed at Zhang Huai, and said loudly, ..
.. “That night, when everyone was asleep, Zhang Huai brought his men to the Cold Palace!
At that time, I was by the courtyard wall, trying to figure out how to climb over it and leave.
As soon as I saw him coming, I hid. I saw Zhang Huai holding a knife and entering the noble consort’s room.
Not long after he went in, the terrified screams of palace maids could be heard from the room.
After a while, Zhang Huai came out of the room holding the knife, which was covered in blood.
He had someone bring a torch, and he threw it at the entrance of the noble consort’s room.
The fire started burning, and a few palace maids were awakened in shock.
They came out in their nightgowns to put out the fire, but they were all killed by Zhang Huai.
I waited for Zhang Huai and his men to leave.
Then, I immediately rushed into the sea of flames and ran into the noble consort’s room.
I saw four palace maids lying on the ground, covered in blood. They were all dead.
The noble consort lay on the bed, her face and body covered in knife wounds.
I thought the noble consort was dead, but when I held her and cried, I saw her eyes move slightly.
The bed was already on fire, so I dragged the noble consort down to the ground.
At this moment, I discovered that there was a young palace maid hiding under the bed.
I dragged her out from under the bed. She was not injured.
When Zhang Huai came in, she hid under the bed, and Zhang Huai didn’t notice her.
She was terrified and was crying in fear. I didn’t have time to respond to her, and I continued dragging the noble consort.
I wanted to drag the noble consort to somewhere with no fire. She saw this and came over in tears to help me.
I want to thank her. She was a palace maid from the Cold Palace, and she knew that there was a back door in that room.
Although she was very timid, with her guidance and help, I managed to drag the noble consort out through the back door.
We found a shabby little storeroom and hid there.
The noble consort was gravely injured. She was on her last breath.
The great fire outside was still burning.
We were very scared because the Cold Palace was not big, and the small storeroom would be discovered sooner or later.”
“Why were you hiding? Why didn’t you go out and find help?” the emperor couldn’t help but ask.
“Find help?” Chu Zhu laughed indignantly with tears in her eyes.
She asked, “Your Majesty, have you ever been to the Cold Palace? Do you know what a wrongdoer is?
Did you know that the wrongdoers who are banished to the Cold Palace never have a chance to get out?
Did you know that no one cares if someone dies in the Cold Palace?”
The emperor’s expression was very complex. He fell silent.
Bao Zheng also had a heavy heart. He asked, “What was the name of the palace maid who helped you?”
“Lan Xiang, her name is Lan Xiang.”
